notablePrerequisites: You control at least six additional nontoken creatures.
description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar six times by sacrificing six additional nontoken creatures, adding {4}{U}{U}.
Cast Misthollow Griffin by paying {2}{U}{U}.
Activate Blade of Shared Souls' equip ability by paying {2}, attaching it to Misthollow Griffin.
Blade of Shared Souls triggers, causing Misthollow Griffin to become a copy of Gerrard.
Put Misthollow Griffin in the graveyard due to the legend rule.
When Misthollow Griffin dies as a copy of Gerrard, it triggers, exiling itself and returning all other artifact and creature cards put into your graveyard this turn to the battlefield.
Repeat.
If you control a seventh additional nontoken creature, you may sacrifice it as well each loop to get infinite colored mana.
